notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.toast.inMain: A terminal's press waits in Daoris's main window
notifications.system.parked.title: {{repository}}: a session waits on you
notifications.system.questParked.title: {{repository}}: quest #{{quest}} parked after its failed sessions
notifications.system.questParked.body: Open Daoris to try it again.
notifications.system.ended.body: Open Daoris to see what it did.
notifications.system.waiting.title: {{repository}}: a start waits for an account
notifications.system.waiting.body: Open Daoris to see which accounts it waits for.
notifications.system.answered.title: {{repository}}: a conversation answered you
notifications.system.confirming.title: A terminal waits for your confirmation
notifications.system.confirming.body: It asks to {{act}}. Open Daoris to confirm or refuse it.
notifications.system.confirming.plain: Open Daoris to confirm or refuse it.
notifications.system.holding.title: {{repository}}: a session holds a tool call for you
notifications.system.holding.help: Ask Daoris holds a tool call for you
notifications.system.holding.body: Open Daoris to answer it before it is refused by itself.
notifications.done.title: Done and failed
notifications.done.expired: A terminal's press to {{act}} went unanswered, and ran out of time
notifications.done.look.hand-over-refuse: A session could not be handed over to another agent
notifications.done.look.hand-over-elsewh: A session could not be handed over: it runs in another Daoris process on this machine
notifications.done.look.hand-over-droppe: An agent's ask to hand its session over was dropped: the session left this machine
notifications.done.look.hand-over-ask-re: An agent's ask to hand its session over was refused by its rule
notifications.done.look.hand-over-failed: An agent's ask to hand its session over could not be carried out
notifications.done.look.handed-back: A quest handed to another agent went back to this machine's agent
notifications.done.look.lost-claim: A session was stopped: another machine took its quest first
notifications.done.look.lost-to-reopen: A session was stopped: your reopen of the work it grew from took its quest
notifications.done.look.meeting-cut: A meeting was cut short: the driver running it stopped
notifications.done.look.brainstorm-cut: A brainstorm was cut short: the driver running it stopped
notifications.done.look.swept: A session left running when Daoris last stopped was ended
notifications.done.look.meeting-failed: A meeting stopped in a round: something failed, and it ended as failed
notifications.done.look.brainstorm-faile: A brainstorm stopped: something failed, and it ended as failed
notifications.done.look.helper-asker-gon: An ask for a helper was refused: the session that asked it has left this machine
notifications.done.look.reopen-unrecorde: A reopen named a session this machine keeps no record of: nobody here was told
notifications.done.look.reopen-tree-gone: A reopened quest's session was told nothing: its tree is gone, so no work is made again
notifications.done.look.plugin-unsound: A plugin stopped after exiting three times within an hour: it starts again once you try it again
